Lilly Roth }} '''Wither''' is a [[channelled]] [[spell]] that applies the [[Hinder]] debuff, which reduces their movement speed, and a stacking [[Withered]] debuff, which increases chaos damage taken, in an area periodically while channelling. ==Skill functions and interactions== This skill applies two different [[debuff|debuffs]] on the target: *{{stl|Withered}}: a debuff that applies {{c|mod|6% increased chaos damage taken}} per stack, up to 15 stacks. Each stack has its own independent duration of 2s, which is not refreshed when applying new stacks. *{{stl|Hinder}}: a debuff that reduces the target movement speed. This debuff duration does not stack, and its duration is constantly refreshed while channelling. *Modifiers to Skill Effect [[duration]], such as {{il|Increased Duration Support}} and being affected by {{il|Malevolence}}, applies to the duration of both of these debuffs. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = increased

You continue performing the same skill. * You need to pay [[mana]] repeatedly to keep the skill going. The channelled skill's mana cost must be paid again to maintain it with a frequency determined by the cast time. If you can't pay, the skill will end, just as if you'd lifted the button. * Dying, being [[stun]]ned, and other game mechanics that interrupt the use of skills will cause channelling to end as well. * Effects which [[trigger]] when you use a skill will only trigger when you initially start channelling - regardless of how long you maintain a channelled skill, it's still the same use of the skill. You need to stop channelling if you want to use it again. }} {{Version history table row|2.1.0| * Added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Navbox Skills}}
